approval.prompt: Stylized low-poly 3D game asset with a clean, readable silhouette and slightly exaggerated proportions. Flat color blocking with minimal fine surface detail, matte hand-painted albedo-only texture, restricted muted palette. No photorealism, no glossy PBR shine, no pixel art. Flat, even, shadowless lighting from all sides on a plain, uniform mid-grey background. Every surface shows its true base color at the same brightness, front and back, with no cast shadows and no highlights. A young frontier soldier in a knee-length wool tunic in deep dark teal that flares at the hem, a leather harness in dark reddish-brown with two straps crossing the chest and back, leather boots in dark reddish-brown, spiky dark hair, empty hands, T-pose.
